description: Tracks product-building and design tool repositories from GitHub signals.

items.description: A cross-platform launcher that simply works
A to-do list, time tracker and daily planner for focused personal work. Private, offline-first and open source.
An Obsidian plugin that embeds Claude Code, Codex and other agents as an AI collaborator in your vault.

Snow Shot is free, open-source screenshot software and a screen recording tool for Windows and macOS, with annotation, scrolling screenshots, offline OCR and image pinning. 免费开源截图软件，支持截图标注、滚动长截图、离线 OCR、贴图与录屏。
Free, open-source tiling window manager for Apple Silicon Macs, with Niri-style scrolling containers and Hyprland-style Dwindle BSP.
Your computers, working as one. Share keyboard, mouse, trackpad, clipboard, drag and drop and audio across Macs and PCs.

NEO Emacs (WIP): GPU powered Emacs written in Rust with a modern display engine. Aiming for modern design & multi-threaded Elisp, 10x performance, zero-pause concurrent GC and 100% Emacs compatibility.
A fast file manager for Windows and macOS that never freezes: tabs, dual panes, archives as folders, Quick Look-style previews. A File Explorer and Finder alternative written in Rust.

Run multiple Claude Desktop accounts at the same time on Mac: separate sign-ins, custom icons, one shared Claude Code setup, and sessions that message each other across accounts. brew install jackson-cmd/tap/claude-multi-desktop
The ultimate open-source Android gesture & one-hand navigation suite. An all-in-one OHO+ (One Hand Operation+), FooView & Quick Cursor alternative with offline OCR and Shizuku.
Alysis AI — one desktop app for building software with Alysis Code, creating documents with Alysis Work, and delegating ongoing tasks to Alysis Owls.
The most complete Dynamic Island and Taskbar for Windows and macOS. Free and open source, built with Tauri, React and Rust.
Forsion is All You Need. A local-first second-brain workbench: your files on one desk, and AI working on it with you.

Native C++20/Rust 13-in-1 Windows suite (~15MB idle, 0 Electron): instant NTFS/app/bookmark/content search (+ 350KB MCP server), persistent clipboard, Text Expander, Listary dialog jump, File Locksmith, 8-lang offline OCR & 1:1 translation, auto-zoom recorder, mouse gestures & <2MB Picasa viewer.
Beauty is productivity. Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi and 40+ more coding agents, side by side in one window.
